datasets.name: Amazon Reviews 2023 — All Beauty
datasets.rights_status: No license assigned by dataset curators; they say the corpus is made available primarily for research.
datasets.use_policy: Local research use only. Do not redistribute raw review text or the populated database without separate permission.
limitations: Historical Amazon data through September 2023; not live reviews or inventory.
Ratings are not human-annotated sentiment labels.

datasets.name: Turkish User Reviews
datasets.provider: Ekin Ekinci and Sevinç İlhan Omurca; UCI Machine Learning Repository
datasets.source_platform: Unnamed website; not identified by UCI
limitations: Text-only; no product identifiers, ratings, or review dates.
Do not represent as a named marketplace or include in cross-platform product comparisons.
Use for exploratory Turkish-language robustness analysis only, with separate results and attribution.
datasets.attribution: Ekinci, E. & İlhan Omurca, S. (2022). Turkish User Reviews [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. CC BY 4.0. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5HK72

not_included: No additional cross-platform review corpus is included. Public candidates and pending rights checks are documented in research/cross_platform_data_clearance.md.
No authorized Flipkart, Myntra, Meesho, Daraz, or Pickaboo review corpus is included.
Amazon Reviews 2023 files and this derived database are not committed to the repository.
